new_rules.name: PrimaryResearchTrigger
new_rules.rule: School/UAT-specific perception, skills, practice-quality, career-intention or service-access claims require direct local evidence; otherwise emit EVIDENCE_GAP and a primary-research task.

new_rules.name: QualificationDemandJoin
new_rules.rule: IPT labour-market alignment needs require an explicit mapping between actual school qualifications/domains and relevant local occupation/sector demand evidence.

new_rules.name: RateShareSemantics
new_rules.rule: Measure type, numerator, denominator/universe and calculation status must be preserved; shares/stocks cannot be relabelled as rates.

new_rules.name: HistoricalPublicationReceipt
new_rules.rule: Historical evidence must be demonstrably available by the reconstruction cutoff; observation period alone is insufficient when publication provenance is uncertain.

new_rules.name: ComplianceSeparation
new_rules.rule: Horizontal/compliance obligations are stored separately from empirical target-group needs unless direct evidence demonstrates prevalence or deficit.

new_rules.name: IndicatorCannotDiagnoseNeed
new_rules.rule: Programme indicators/results are excluded from the evidence pool used to establish a need and enter only after need discovery during intervention traceability.

new_rules.name: RawSurveyCanonical
new_rules.rule: Primary-research raw response data is canonical; all totals, charts, distributions and narrative are deterministically generated from raw data with missingness recorded.

new_rules.name: PopulationSnapshotLock
new_rules.rule: Every school-level evidence item and need references a population snapshot; cross-version cohort or qualification changes require explicit reconciliation and may not silently overwrite history.

new_rules.name: EvidenceGapFirstClass
new_rules.rule: Missing evidence is a valid explicit output. The narrative generator may not fill an unresolved evidence gap with generic prose or inference.

new_rules.name: AcceptedClaimSkepticism
new_rules.rule: Evaluator acceptance and factual/evidentiary validity are distinct fields; accepted legacy claims with weak evidence are not automatically learned as true.
